checkin.title: Today's Check-in
checkin.desc: Track your temperature, blood pressure, and how you feel today.

tips: Drink at least 8 glasses of clean, boiled or filtered water every day to stay energized.
Wash hands thoroughly with soap before meals and after using the restroom.
Take your prescribed medicines on time and never skip doses without consulting your doctor or ASHA worker.
Include green leafy vegetables and seasonal fruits in your daily diet for stronger immunity.
Get at least 30 minutes of walking or gentle exercise daily to maintain heart health.
